disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全仓库扫描了凭据类敏感信息引用（API Key、token、secret、SSH 私钥、云凭据路径等），未发现插件读取这些路径的代码；相关命中均为文档说明、benchmark 统计字段或测试数据。
checked_items.en: The entire repository was scanned for credential-type sensitive information references (API keys, tokens, secrets, SSH private keys, cloud credential paths, etc.), and no code was found where the plugin reads these paths; the relevant hits were all documentation descriptions, benchmark statistics fields, or test data.

checked_items.zh: dsh 扩展仅读取自身的技能目录与 ~/.config/aegis/config.toml 用户配置，不访问任何凭据存储位置。
checked_items.en: The dsh extension only reads its own skill directory and the ~/.config/aegis/config.toml user configuration, and does not access any credential storage locations.

evidence.zh: 未发现插件读取凭据文件（如宿主凭据、SSH 私钥）或引用其路径的代码；dsh 扩展仅读取自身技能目录与 ~/.config/aegis/config.toml。
evidence.en: No code was found where the plugin reads credential files (such as host credentials or SSH private keys) or references their paths; the dsh extension only reads its own skill directory and ~/.config/aegis/config.toml.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 dsh 扩展注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js）与 using-aegis 技能内容：为方法包路由纪律（要求先加载对应技能或声明 fast-path），并明确用户指令优先，未发现窃取、自改、越权等恶意指令。
checked_items.en: The bootstrap text injected into the model by the dsh extension (extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js) and the using-aegis skill content were reviewed: they establish method-package routing discipline (requiring loading the corresponding skill first or declaring a fast-path) and explicitly state that user instructions take precedence; no malicious instructions such as theft, self-modification, or privilege escalation were found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 hooks 目录下各宿主会话钩子注入的文案：仅为用户可见的配置迁移提醒，无恶意内容。
checked_items.en: The text injected by each host session hook under the hooks directory was reviewed: it is only user-visible configuration migration reminders, with no malicious content.

checked_items.zh: 审查了各宿主安装文档中的引导文本，未发现诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
checked_items.en: The bootstrap text in each host's installation documentation was reviewed, and no wording was found that induces the model to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or grant permissions.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展未注册任何工具、不产生工具描述文本；注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js）为路由纪律且声明用户指令优先，无恶意指令。
evidence.en: The dsh extension registers no tools and produces no tool description text; the bootstrap text injected into the model (extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js) is routing discipline and declares user instructions take precedence, with no malicious instructions.

evidence.zh: 引导文案与技能文档均未出现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；docs/README.deepseek-harness.md 中的安装命令为面向用户的正常安装说明。
evidence.en: Neither the bootstrap text nor the skill documentation contains wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation; the installation command in docs/README.deepseek-harness.md is a normal install instruction for users.

checked_items.zh: 对预扫描提示的 5 处代码执行类机械命中逐条人工核查并全部排除：CI 工作流（DSH-X07 对应 DG-R3-59）为常规 CI（checkout、安装 Python、跑测试），无远程载荷下载执行；OpenCode 宿主插件（DSH-X03 对应 DG-R3-55）按仓库文档仅用于启动时的版本自检；技能目录图表渲染脚本（DSH-X03 对应 DG-R3-55）只用固定命令调用本机 graphviz；两个 README 徽标中的高熵 base64 串（DSH-X08 对应 DG-R3-60）实为 SVG 图片数据，非代码。
checked_items.en: The 5 mechanical code-execution hits flagged by pre-scan were manually verified one by one and all ruled out: the CI workflow (DSH-X07 corresponding to DG-R3-59) is a normal CI (checkout, install Python, run tests) with no remote payload download-and-execute; the OpenCode host plugin (DSH-X03 corresponding to DG-R3-55) is, per the repository documentation, only used for version self-check at startup; the skill-directory chart-rendering script (DSH-X03 corresponding to DG-R3-55) only invokes local graphviz with fixed commands; the high-entropy base64 strings in the two README badges (DSH-X08 corresponding to DG-R3-60) are actually SVG image data, not code.

checked_items.zh: 核查 dsh 挂载补丁 extensions/dsh/cordis.patch.yml：仅插入一行插件声明，不含 !!js 可执行标签，不触碰任何安全配置行。
checked_items.en: The dsh patch extensions/dsh/cordis.patch.yml was checked: it only inserts a single plugin declaration line, contains no !!js executable tags, and does not touch any security configuration lines.

checked_items.zh: 检查 package.json：无任何安装或准备钩子；dsh 扩展代码未使用 eval、动态函数或子进程。
checked_items.en: package.json was checked: there are no install or prepare hooks; the dsh extension code does not use eval, dynamic functions, or subprocesses.

checked_items.zh: 全仓库未发现对宿主动态代码执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，也未声明 dsh.client 浏览器端入口。
checked_items.en: No calls to host dynamic code execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run class) were found across the repository, and no dsh.client browser-side entry point is declared.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 extensions/dsh/cordis.patch.yml 仅插入一行插件声明，不含 !!js 可执行标量。
evidence.en: The patch extensions/dsh/cordis.patch.yml only inserts a single plugin declaration line and contains no !!js executable scalars.

evidence.zh: 全仓库未发现对宿主动态代码执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic code execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run class) were found across the repository; the scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装或准备钩子；OpenCode 宿主插件存在文档化的启动版本自检（对比远端 HEAD 并重置缓存，见 docs/README.opencode.md），属该宿主适配的透明设计，非 dsh 接入面。
evidence.en: package.json has no install or prepare hooks; the OpenCode host plugin has a documented startup version self-check (comparing remote HEAD and resetting the cache, see docs/README.opencode.md), which is a transparent design of that host adapter and not part of the dsh integration surface.

evidence.zh: manifest 未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器端自动加载面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The manifest does not declare dsh.client, so there is no browser-side auto-load surface; the scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查 dsh 扩展与 pi/omp 共享适配代码的网络调用面：未发现任何 HTTP、WebSocket 或套接字外联调用，扩展只读写本地文件并向模型注入文案。
checked_items.en: The network call surface of the dsh extension and the shared pi/omp adapter code was examined: no HTTP, WebSocket, or socket outbound calls were found; the extension only reads and writes local files and injects text into the model.

checked_items.zh: 对预扫描提示的 4 处网络命令机械命中（DSH-C05 对应 DG-R4-53）逐条核查并全部排除：OMP 宿主安装文档中的一行第三方安装命令、两处测试数据、一处测试工具中的禁用命令清单（用于拦截网络命令），均非插件本体外联行为。
checked_items.en: The 4 mechanical network-command hits flagged by pre-scan (DSH-C05 corresponding to DG-R4-53) were manually verified one by one and all ruled out: a third-party install command line in the OMP host installation doc, two test data entries, and a disabled-command list in a test tool (used to block network commands); none are outbound behavior of the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 脚本目录的更新工具仅在用户显式执行时对本地 git 仓库做 fetch 与 fast-forward 合并，不自动联网外发数据；dsh 官方文档明确 bundle 安装不使用该工具。
checked_items.en: The update tool under the scripts directory only performs fetch and fast-forward merges on the local git repository when explicitly executed by the user; it does not automatically go online to exfiltrate data. The official dsh documentation clearly states that bundle installation does not use this tool.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展与共享适配代码无任何网络外联调用；未发现凭据读取加外发的组合通道。
evidence.en: The dsh extension and shared adapter code have no outbound network calls; no combined credential-read-plus-exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查 package.json 依赖面：无运行时第三方依赖，仅声明可选的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 宿主对等依赖；无安装脚本，供应链执行面最小。
checked_items.en: The package.json dependency surface was checked: there are no runtime third-party dependencies, only optional host peer dependencies declared as @deepseek-ai/dsh-*; no install scripts, minimizing the supply chain execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 核查 dsh 挂载补丁：仅插入自身插件行，不覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法，未改写 inject/intercept 配置。
checked_items.en: The dsh patch was checked: it only inserts its own plugin line, does not override security configurations such as sandbox/approval/permission, has no disabled or environment-variable downgrade patterns, and does not rewrite inject/intercept configurations.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对工具预执行、审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断逻辑，不存在截断审批链的代码。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listeners or truncation logic for security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests were found; there is no code that truncates the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 作者与仓库归属一致、名称无仿冒迹象；首次审计无版本基线，无法比较版本间能力变化（升级自动激活场景不适用）。
checked_items.en: The author and repository attribution are consistent and the name shows no signs of impersonation; this is the first audit with no version baseline, so capability changes across versions cannot be compared (the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 安全配置行，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch sandbox/approval/permission security configuration lines and has no disabled or environment-variable downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批、工具执行等安全事件的高优先级监听（prepend），不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners (prepend) for security events such as approvals or tool execution were found; there is no code that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比较版本间能力声明变化，场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no previous version baseline, so capability declaration changes across versions cannot be compared; the scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写 inject/intercept 配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configurations.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主自身无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable. Unauthenticated RPC in the host itself is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱运行验证（无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论基于静态代码与仓库文档；DeepSeek Harness 官方为开发者预览版，文档已如实标注。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox execution verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static code and repository documentation. DeepSeek Harness is officially a developer preview, and the documentation accurately states this.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; unauthenticated RPC on the local machine is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin; the scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 已确认该快照为 dsh 生态插件：package.json 声明 dsh.bundle.patch 挂载补丁并可选依赖 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 宿主包；插件身份、版本与 commit 与任务卡一致。
summary.en: It is confirmed that this snapshot is a dsh ecosystem plugin: package.json declares the dsh.bundle.patch and optionally depends on the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* host packages; the plugin identity, version, and commit match the task card.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未在 dsh 接入面发现危险执行模式（无 eval、动态函数、!!js 标签、安装钩子）；预扫描的 9 处机械命中逐条核查后全部判定为良性用途。
summary.en: Static scanning did not find dangerous execution patterns on the dsh integration surface (no eval, dynamic functions, !!js tags, or install hooks); all 9 mechanical hits from the pre-scan were manually checked and judged benign.

summary.zh: 行为面分析未发现凭据读取、网络外联、混淆载荷或持久化写入；扩展代码仅读取本地技能目录与用户配置并向模型注入文案。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis found no credential reads, network exfiltration, obfuscated payloads, or persistence writes; the extension code only reads local skill directories and user configuration and injects text into the model.

summary.zh: 对注入模型的引导文案与技能内容进行语义审查，内容为方法包路由纪律且明确用户指令优先，未发现恶意指令或诱导安装行为。
summary.en: Semantic review of the bootstrap text and skill content injected into the model found that the content is method-package routing discipline and explicitly states user instructions take precedence; no malicious instructions or installation-inducing behavior were found.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论基于静态与文档证据。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and documentation evidence.

target.zh: aegis@2.8.5#fea84dd5（仓库根，全量审计；插件为多宿主方法包，dsh 接入面为 package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch 与 extensions/dsh/）
target.en: aegis@2.8.5#fea84dd5 (repository root, full audit; the plugin is a multi-host method package, and the dsh integration surface is dsh.bundle.patch in package.json and extensions/dsh/)

limits.zh: 隐藏目录（.github/、.opencode/、.claude-plugin/ 等）在平台文件清单中存在但本审计环境无法直接读取，相关机械命中依据预扫描摘录与仓库内文档裁决；未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）；manifest 未显式声明能力，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断；DeepSeek Harness 官方为开发者预览版；dsh 官方文档说明 bundle 安装不经过 scripts/ 目录的更新工具。
limits.en: Hidden directories (.github/, .opencode/, .claude-plugin/, etc.) exist in the platform file listing but could not be read directly in this audit environment; relevant mechanical hits were adjudicated based on pre-scan excerpts and repository documentation. No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts). The manifest does not explicitly declare capabilities; declared_capabilities were inferred from code measurement. DeepSeek Harness is officially a developer preview. The official dsh documentation states that bundle installation does not pass through the update tool in scripts/.
